So... I shipped v0.2.0 for Android 9 and newer, then suddenly remembered that x86 Lollipop tablets are still alive out there. Somewhere, an old Intel tablet from 2014 is still charging in a drawer, and it deserves a Capture the Flag match too. This release is for it.

## What's new

- **Android 5.0 and newer** (it needed Android 9 before). Phones and tablets from 2014 on can play now.
- **Intel-based Android devices** are in: old Intel phones and tablets (yes, you, Lollipop tablet), Chromebooks and emulators. The APK now carries builds for ARM and Intel, so it grew from 2.3 MB to 4.8 MB. Still lighter than most app icons, honestly.

Nothing else changed: same game as v0.2.0, with all six new match types, the Hail Rifle, the finished map editor and Bahasa Indonesia.

## Download and play

- **Android (5.0 and newer):** download `arcane-dome-v0.2.1-android.apk` on your device and open it (allow installing from your browser or file manager when asked). It installs straight over v0.2.0. If you have an old test build of Arcane Dome, uninstall that first.
- **Windows:** download `arcane-dome-v0.2.1-windows-x86_64.zip`, unzip it, run `arcane-dome.exe`.
- **Linux:** download `arcane-dome-v0.2.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, unpack it, run `./arcane-dome`. Needs the usual desktop libraries (ALSA, X11, Xi, OpenGL), which most desktops already have.

On Windows and Linux, keep the `assets` folder next to the game.

Full history: `CHANGELOG.md`, or View Changes in the game.
